scripts.api:spec: mise exec -- poetry -C ../api run python scripts/export_openapi.py --output ../web/openapi/openapi.json
scripts.api:generate: pnpm run api:spec && openapi-generator-cli generate -c openapi-generator-config.json && node scripts/normalize-generated.mjs
scripts.api:check: pnpm run api:generate && git diff --exit-code -- openapi/openapi.json src/api/generated
scripts.check: pnpm run api:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
